grubby inn#309944.description: You are inside the old Grubby Inn.  This place has not been cleaned for several decades; vile smells make you dizzy.
grubby inn#309944.name: Grubby Inn

main street#9081dc.description: You are on the main street passing through the City of Midgaard.  South of here is the entrance to the Armory, and the bakery is to the north.  East of here is the market square.
main street#9081dc.name: Main Street

market square#9081dc.description: You are standing on the market square, the famous Square of Midgaard. A large, peculiar looking statue is standing in the middle of the square. Roads lead in every direction, north to the temple square, south to the common square, east and westbound is the main street.
market square#9081dc.name: Market Square

poor alley#94ced5.description: You are on Poor Alley, which continues further east.  You see the city wall to the west.
poor alley#94ced5.name: Poor Alley

the armory#309944.description: The armory has a wide assortment of armor displayed on the walls and in the windows. Helmets, shields, and suits of armor are for sale. To the north is the main street. On the wall is a small note.
the armory#309944.name: The Armory

the bakery#7e3fb5.description: You are standing inside the small bakery.  A sweet scent of danish and fine bread fills the room.  The bread and Danish are arranged in fine order on the shelves, and seem to be of the finest quality. A small sign is on the counter.
the bakery#7e3fb5.name: The Bakery

the beggar ducks under your fist as you.description: Poor Alley You are on Poor Alley, which continues further east.  You see the city wall to the west.
the beggar ducks under your fist as you.name: The beggar ducks under your fist as you try to hit her.

the common square#9081dc.description: The common square, people pass you, talking to each other.  To the west is the poor alley and to the east is the dark alley.  To the north, this square is connected to the market square.  From the south you notice a nasty smell.
the common square#9081dc.name: The Common Square

the eastern end of poor alley#0c54ab.description: You are at the poor alley.  South of here is the Grubby Inn and to the east you see common square.  The alley continues further west.
the eastern end of poor alley#0c54ab.name: The Eastern End Of Poor Alley

the temple of midgaard#06357f.description: You are in the southern end of the temple hall in the Temple of Midgaard. The temple has been constructed from giant marble blocks, eternal in appearance, and most of the walls are covered by ancient wall paintings picturing Gods, giants and peasants. Large steps lead down through the grand temple gate, descending the huge mound upon which the temple is built and ends on the temple square below. To the west, you see the Reading Room.  The donation room is in a small alcove to your east.
the temple of midgaard#06357f.name: The Temple Of Midgaard

the temple square#9081dc.description: You are standing on the temple square.  Huge marble steps lead up to the temple gate.  The entrance to the Clerics' Guild is to the west, and the old Grunting Boar Inn, is to the east.  Just south of here you see the market square, the center of Midgaard.
the temple square#9081dc.name: The Temple Square

wall road#947519.description: You are walking next to the western city wall.  Wall Road continues further north and south.  A small, poor alley leads east. Some letters have been written on the wall here.
wall road#947519.name: Wall Road
